pat_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Airtable Personal Access Token (starts with pat...). The worker reads os.environ[pat_env] at runtime — never store the token value here.

default_base_id.description: Default base ID (app...) used when --base-id is not specified on the CLI.

default_table_id.description: Default table ID (tbl...) or table name used when --table-id is not specified on the CLI.

env.description: Runtime environment. Controls attestation strictness: dev skips HMAC verification, prod requires WCP_ATTEST_HMAC_KEY.
